data.content:
Luciano Spalletti's biggest headache is the long injury list: Kenan Yildiz, Khéphren Thuram, Manuel Locatelli, Francisco Conceição, Zeki Çelik and Nicolás González are all unavailable. The returns of Jérémie Boga and Juan Cabal give the coach slightly more options, while Lloyd Kelly, Edon Zhegrova and Pape Sarr could also be handed playing time. The hosts are trying to emerge from a prolonged goalscoring crisis, while the Turin side are looking to cut their eight-point deficit to the Serie A leaders. Despite significant absences, Luciano Spalletti's team head into the match as favorites.
